paragraphs: Videray Technologies, founded in 2018 by a group of engineers in Boston, Massachusetts, develops non-intrusive inspection and imaging technology. Its home page describes what it makes as a portable handheld backscatter X-ray imager. The buyers it names are law enforcement officials who face criminal techniques while performing their duties in the field.

The company attributes image depth to 140 keV of power and its optics, which it says allow seeing through more material. The product is called the PX1, and Videray credits it with advanced image processing and image clarity. Portability and connectivity are presented as ways to speed up inspection, allowing quick scans and dispositioning of potential threats.

Videray positions the system for mission-critical imaging work where the overall system footprint or the scan standoff distance may be constrained. Paul Bradshaw is the chief executive officer. Headquarters are at 529 Main Street, Suite 100, Charlestown, MA 02129.

paragraphs: SurePassID sells deploy-anywhere multi-factor authentication for IT/OT and critical infrastructure, deployable in the cloud, on-premise, or within air-gapped networks. It covers Windows, MacOS, and Linux logins with offline 2FA and fronts cloud and on-prem apps through SAML2, OIDC, and LDAP identity providers. The company cites 99.999% availability, redundancy, and automatic failover, and markets the product for compliance with OMB M-22-09, CMMC 2.0, and NIS2. It supports phishing-resistant MFA through FIDO2/WebAuthn passkeys and security keys as well as OATH HOTP, TOTP, and OCRA tokens and mobile push.

SurePassID has provided on-premise MFA since its founding in 2012 and says 50% of its customer base, including Fortune 500 companies, uses it on-premise. It also serves financial services, having introduced a private cloud authentication server for online payments licensed by Visa, MasterCard, American Express, First Data, and Discover. About 33% of its install base runs in air-gapped environments, and it provides air-gapped MFA to 11 of 16 critical infrastructure sectors. It offers turnkey MFA for SCIFs and SAPFs and pre-built integrations for SCADA systems such as EcoStruxure Geo SCADA Expert.

Private cloud deployments run in Microsoft Azure Commercial, GCC, and GCC High and in Amazon AWS and AWS GovCloud. As a SAML 2.0 identity provider it adds MFA to existing IAM tools such as Microsoft Entra, Okta, or Ping, and integrates with Workday, Oracle, and SAP directories.

paragraphs: Julota sells a platform that gives emergency responders, clinical practitioners and case workers the same longitudinal view of an individual's history. The company says it makes existing software systems interoperable without new hardware, with data, workflows and reports reached through any browser. Consent management is part of the platform, and Julota states that it is HIPAA and 42CFR compliant. Programs listed as users include crisis intervention teams and community response teams.

Co-founder Rick Pionkowski, an ER doctor at Penrose Hospital in Colorado Springs, saw a disconnected system of community providers produce repeat low-acuity patients at the ER. The first client was the Colorado Springs Fire Department and its Mobile Integrated Healthcare program, CARES. Law enforcement behavioral health followed with the El Paso County Sheriffs office and its Crisis Response Team program.

Julota says it supports co-responder programs across the state of Washington and won its first state contract with the State of Idaho Department of Behavioral Health. It was later selected as the platform for the Southwest Texas Regional Advisory Council, as designated by the Texas Department of State Health Services.

quote.text: Julota transforms the disconnected patchwork of local service providers into a well-coordinated network that serves the community efficiently.

In June 2026 the company announced an agreement to be acquired by Motorola Solutions. Its newsroom now states that it has officially joined Motorola Solutions.

paragraphs: Off Duty Management administers off-duty work programs for law enforcement agencies, their officers, and community businesses. Its OfficerTRAK® platform handles Police, Fire, or EMS off-duty job requests. Officers clock in and out, view job history, and get real-time notifications in the OfficerTRAK® app. The businesses hiring officers request shifts, receive invoices, and pay online through a portal.

Off Duty Management charges nothing to agencies and officers. It takes on the financial risk of late or non-payment by the off-duty employer, and says officers and agencies are paid weekly regardless of customer payment status. The company reports partnering with over 200 primary agencies and 300 backup agencies across the nation.

In Arizona, it deploys trained SSO officers across jurisdictions to help school districts fill School Safety Officer shifts. The Arizona Department of Education sets a curriculum officers must complete to be eligible for those shifts. Superintendent Tom Horne extended that partnership with Off Duty Management through 2026. Retired Austin Police Chief Brian Manley joined the company as President.

paragraphs: SkySafe sells a drone detection and airspace intelligence platform that identifies drone activity in real time and supports building legally sound cases after incidents. The company states the platform detects 96% of drone models, including drones flying without active signals. It can pinpoint where a drone took off, where it landed and the location of its controller. Alerts go out through SMS, Microsoft Teams, Slack, CommandCentral Aware or an existing ops stack. The platform produces forensic reports intended for law enforcement or federal agencies.

One case study describes how a near-miss drone flight over a crowd of 10,000 at Fort Adams State Park led Rhode Island toward a statewide drone detection strategy. The University of Illinois Police Department used SkySafe to monitor and respond to drone activity across campus events and facilities, and the University of Louisiana at Monroe uses it to separate authorized university flights from unauthorized activity. Other case studies cover an aerospace company that cut drone response time from 20 minutes to a few minutes and a PGA Tour event at Torrey Pines.

CEO Grant Jordan served as an officer in the Air Force for four years after graduating from MIT and later led Somerset Recon. Mike Spindel, Co-Founder and Engineering Fellow, oversees the drone defense systems.

paragraphs: SoundThinking, Inc., listed on Nasdaq as SSTI, sells AI and data-driven public safety technology to law enforcement, civic leadership, and security professionals. The company reports more than 300 customers and work with approximately 2,100 agencies. Its SafetySmart Platform includes ShotSpotter, an acoustic gunshot detection system that detects and verifies gunfire incidents in near real time. The platform also includes CrimeTracer, a law enforcement search engine, and CaseBuilder, an investigation management system. ResourceRouter directs patrol and community anti-violence resources, and SafePointe is an AI-based weapons detection system. PlateRanger connects vehicle sightings across time, location, and related events for investigations.

The company was founded as ShotSpotter in 1996 by physicist Dr. Robert Showen, who was then working on locating earthquake epicenters at the Stanford Research Institute in Menlo Park, California. Ralph Clark was hired as CEO in 2010 and changed the model so the system was sold as a subscription rather than as a capital hardware purchase. He also set up a centralized Incident Review Center so that human review of potential gunshots was done in-house rather than by police departments. The gunshot detection service now serves over 170 cities. In 2023 the company rebranded from ShotSpotter to SoundThinking and launched the SafetySmart Platform.

paragraphs: TRM Labs makes blockchain intelligence software that helps investigators detect, investigate and disrupt crypto-related crime. The company says 600+ government agencies and financial institutions across 75 countries rely on its data, software and AI agents. It maps the criminal economy across 40+ categories of illicit activity and says it has done so for nearly a decade.

Its buyer segments are law enforcement, defense and intelligence, regulators and supervisors, banks and financial institutions, crypto exchanges and fintechs, and cyber threat intelligence teams. Named products include TRM Forensics, Co-Case Agent, Compliance360, Seizure360, NatSec360, the BLOCKINT API and TRM Bulk Data. Co-Case Agent is built into TRM Forensics and reasons across blockchain records, threat-actor intelligence and victim reports to cluster syndicates, build freeze packages and triage tipline leads. The compliance product covers 184+ chains and 840+ cross-chain bridges. Through the Beacon Network, VASPs are notified in real time when law enforcement flags illicit funds reaching their services.

TRM also offers TRM Academy training and a monthly working group for law enforcement called LEO Labs. The company says its intelligence has supported convictions, asset freezes and OFAC designations in multiple jurisdictions. Case studies on the site feature Visa, XREX and the 1inch Network, and strategic partners include Flashpoint, Magnet Forensics, Searchlight Cyber and i2.

paragraphs: VeriPic sells a suite of digital evidence management products to law enforcement and public safety agencies. The suite runs from collecting evidence in the field through citizen-submitted uploads, organized storage, redaction and courtroom preparation. The company says agencies can use it to reduce case processing time, respond faster to FOIA and discovery requests, and organize files by case, officer or keyword.

At the center is Digital Evidence Manager (DEM), a hub where evidence from body cams, mobile uploads and witness submissions is stored, organized and accessed. Officers feed it from the field with the Evi-Pad app, which captures photo, video, audio and notes tagged by case and uploaded in real time. The public can send media through a Witness Upload web portal with no app required, and Automated Redaction blurs faces and mutes audio inside DEM. VeriPic Drive adds cloud storage for large-scale video, forensic data and long-term archives, and the product menu also lists body worn cameras, Detect-a-Fake photo authentication and a Mug Shot System. Selected files can be shared with prosecutors and other stakeholders.

VeriPic says it has partnered with law enforcement agencies for over 20 years. It positions the suite for local, county and state agencies, whether a rural department, a large metro unit or a statewide law enforcement system.

paragraphs: Sentrycs makes counter-drone systems that detect, track, identify, and mitigate unauthorized drones for defense, homeland security, and critical infrastructure environments. The system uses passive RF cyber technology rather than radar to detect drones and to locate their operators. Detection reports the drone type, serial number, and operator position. Mitigation is non-jamming and uses a cyber takeover of the drone, and the system can integrate with any type of effector, including jammers, if required.

The company describes Counter UAS systems as tools used by defense organizations, homeland security agencies, and critical infrastructure operators to protect sensitive airspace. Its blog also addresses law enforcement, including a post on how to legally take down a rogue drone.

The Sentrycs team of Communications and Radio Frequency experts began developing modular counter-drone solutions in 2017. On November 18th, 2025, Ondas Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:ONDS) announced it had completed the acquisition of Sentrycs.

paragraphs: Sentrycs makes counter-drone systems that detect, track, identify and mitigate unauthorized drones for defense, homeland security and critical infrastructure environments. Rather than radar, it uses passive RF cyber technology to pick up drone communication signals and locate both the drone and its operator. Detection reports the drone type, serial number and operator position. Mitigation does not jam the drone; the system takes control of it through a cyber takeover. If required, it integrates with other types of effector, including jammers.

The company says a team of communications and radio frequency experts embarked in 2017 on developing modular solutions that could be tailored to each customer's drone environment. The system is built for complex and urban environments, where it aims to minimize interference with surrounding communications. It says its customers include governments, security forces and critical infrastructure operators worldwide. Its blog is aimed partly at law enforcement, with posts on how to legally take down a rogue drone and on lessons from recent UAS attacks.

On November 18th, 2025, Ondas Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:ONDS) announced it had completed the acquisition of Sentrycs. The announcement describes the company as Sentry CS Ltd., based in Israel. It puts Sentrycs at approximately 200 deployments across six continents in more than 25 countries.

paragraphs.text: The site says over 1,500 agencies nationwide use it.
paragraphs.quote: Trusted by Over 1,500 Agencies Nationwide

paragraphs.text: Penlink sells a digital intelligence platform to public safety agencies and enterprises, which use it to turn complex data into intelligence for investigations and security work.

paragraphs.quote: lawful live data collection, including phone calls, texts, and web activity

paragraphs.quote: Automate the search and analysis of data from the open, deep, and the dark web.

paragraphs.text: It coordinates discovery, analysis and follow-up across PLX, Tangles and GeoTime in a single workflow.

paragraphs.quote: SOC 2 · ISO · CJIS compliant

paragraphs.quote: Using PLX, one agency increased its solvability rate from 28% to over 40% in the first month alone.

paragraphs.text: A partnership with Chainalysis brings blockchain intelligence into the platform, connecting on-chain activity to identities, communications and locations.
paragraphs.quote: Penlink and Chainalysis have partnered to bring blockchain intelligence directly into Penlink’s digital intelligence platform

paragraphs.text: Pimloc sells Secure Redact, an automated system for the bulk redaction of personal data from video.
paragraphs.quote: Pimloc has developed an automated solution for the bulk redaction of personal data from video called Secure Redact.

paragraphs.text: It is aimed at private and public organizations that want to automate data privacy compliance while still getting operational value from their video.
paragraphs.quote: Pimloc is helping private and public organizations across the globe to automate data privacy compliance whilst responsibly unlocking the operational value of multi-modal data intelligence.

paragraphs.text: Customers use it to process video for data subject access requests and freedom of information requests.
paragraphs.quote: facilitate the efficient processing of video for data subject access requests (DSAR) and freedom of information requests (FOIA).

paragraphs.text: The system's models recognize identifiers such as faces, heads and license plates the way a human observer would, then redact and classify them automatically.

paragraphs.text: It can be applied selectively, removing some or all faces or all vehicle registration details, and it is trained to perform on low-definition CCTV footage.
paragraphs.quote: Pimloc’s technology can be deployed selectively, so it can remove some or all faces, and/or all vehicle registration details, or other identifying information.

paragraphs.text: Pimloc states that Secure Redact detects and anonymizes over 99% of identifiable PII in security video.
paragraphs.quote: Secure Redact detects and anonymizes over 99% of identifiable PII in security video.

paragraphs.text: It also says redaction with its AI runs 200 times faster than doing the job by hand.
paragraphs.quote: the task of redaction can be completed 200x faster

paragraphs.text: The company says its capabilities are deployed across transport, public safety, telehealth, insurance, retail, policing and local government.
paragraphs.quote: Pimloc’s capabilities are currently being deployed across a range of sectors, including transport, public safety, telehealth, insurance, retail, policing and local government.

paragraphs.text: A second product, Pholio, classifies visual content, and Pimloc has used it to evaluate automated detection of online harms.
paragraphs.quote: Pimloc has used its Pholio system to evaluate the potential for automated and augmented online harms detection.

paragraphs.text: Founders Simon Randall, the CEO, and James Leigh, the CTO, co-created the Autographer wearable image capture device at a previous business, and the privacy challenges of always-on capture led them to start Pimloc.
paragraphs.quote: our Founders Simon Randall (CEO) and James Leigh (CTO), co-created within a previous business.

quote.text: Automated anonymization is the only way to keep up with changing privacy legislation and to responsibly unlock the value of aggregated video data for business operations.

before.name: FaceTec
before.why: | revised by second reader: Every fact traces to the home page and nothing is invented, but the opening names the product category without saying who buys it, and paragraphs two and three are loosely stitched facts rather than prose. Reworded from the same page.

paragraphs.text: FaceTec sells face verification software that organizations use to confirm a remote user is real and physically present, both at account onboarding and on later logins.
paragraphs.quote: FaceTec proves the Correct User is physically present by Matching them to their ID Photo or 3D FaceMap.

paragraphs.text: Its products cover 3D liveness checks, KYC and 3D face verification, running from an ordinary 2D camera rather than infrared hardware.
paragraphs.quote: 3D Liveness, KYC & 3D Face Verification Software

paragraphs.text: During onboarding the software records a quick video selfie, verifies 3D liveness, matches the resulting 3D FaceMap to the photo on the ID and checks the ID for signs of tampering.
paragraphs.quote: records a quick video-selfie, verifies 3D Liveness, matches the 3D FaceMap

paragraphs.text: When the user returns, a new video selfie is compared with the stored FaceMap, and a high match, which FaceTec rates at 1/125M FAR, can grant account access.
paragraphs.quote: If they match highly (1/125M FAR), the user can be granted access.

paragraphs.text: FaceTec has run a Spoof Bounty Program since October 2019 and says it has passed Ingenium, Bixelab, Praetorian and iBeta Testing Lab Level 1-5 PAD and IAD testing with 0% FAR.
paragraphs.quote: Operating a Spoof Bounty Program since October 2019, and passing Ingenium, Bixelab, Praetorian & iBeta Testing Lab Level 1-5 PAD& IAD testing with 0% FAR

paragraphs.text: The bounty currently stands at $600,000.
paragraphs.quote: $600,000 Spoof Bounty Program

paragraphs.text: The company's stated best practice is for customers to keep users' biometric data, as 3D FaceMap or 3D FaceVector records, on their own servers, which run FaceTec's software inside the customer's firewall.
paragraphs.quote: on Your servers which run our software inside your firewall

paragraphs.text: A related product, UR Codes, carries digitally signed biometric data so a codeholder can prove legal identity and age both in person and remotely.
paragraphs.quote: UR Codes contain digitally signed biometric data and enable privacy-preserving in-person and remote Identity Verification.

paragraphs.text: FaceTec says it trained its 3D algorithms with the help of over half a million volunteer testers from over 180 countries.
paragraphs.quote: FaceTec trained its 3D Algorithms with the help of over half-a-million volunteer testers from over 180 countries.

paragraphs.text: GovWorx sells CommsCoach, an AI-powered software platform that emergency communications centers use to hire, train, evaluate and support 9-1-1 telecommunicators.

paragraphs.quote: Designed for leaders responsible for improving the impact of 9-1-1 professionals.

paragraphs.text: Its modules follow a telecommunicator from candidate through career, linking HIRE, TRAIN, QA and ASSIST in one system, with PROMOTE added for choosing supervisors.

paragraphs.text: QA automatically pulls every eligible call and radio transmission, matches transcripts to CAD event data and scores them against the agency's own policies.
paragraphs.quote: Automatically pulls every eligible call and radio transmission, capturing the center activity without extra work.

paragraphs.text: In June 2026 APCO International and GovWorx announced a partnership to bring APCO's communications protocols into CommsCoach ASSIST.
paragraphs.quote: APCO International and GovWorx have announced a partnership to bring APCO’s recognized communications protocols into GovWorx’s CommsCoach ASSIST platform.

paragraphs.text: In August 2026 GovWorx added NEAL, an adaptive non-emergency call handling tool that escalates to a human telecommunicator whenever judgment is needed.

paragraphs.quote: ResourceRouter, software that directs patrol and community anti-violence resources to help maximize their impact

paragraphs.text: SafePointe screens entry points in high-traffic environments for weapons.

paragraphs.text: PlateRanger connects vehicle sightings across time, location, and related events for investigators.
paragraphs.quote: Connect vehicle sightings across time, location, and related events to expand investigative awareness and operational context.

paragraphs.quote: The company originally known as ShotSpotter was founded in 1996 while physicist Dr. Robert Showen

paragraphs.quote: Dr. Showen had the idea of applying the similar sound wave principles he was using for his earthquake research to detect and locate gunshots

paragraphs.text: The gunshot detection service now serves over 170 cities.
paragraphs.quote: the product now serves over 170 cities

paragraphs.text: In 2023 the company rebranded from ShotSpotter to SoundThinking and launched the SafetySmart Platform.
paragraphs.quote: corporate rebranding from ShotSpotter to SoundThinking to reflect its broader mission

paragraphs.text: SkySafe sells a drone detection and airspace intelligence platform that gives businesses the visibility and forensic detail to identify drone activity in real time and build legally sound cases when incidents occur.
paragraphs.quote: SkySafe's drone detection & airspace intelligence platform gives businesses the visibility and forensics intel to identify drone activity in real time

paragraphs.text: The company states the platform detects 96% of drone models, including drones flying without active signals.
paragraphs.quote: Identify nearly every drone manufacturer in real time, even those flying without active signals.

paragraphs.text: It can pinpoint where a drone took off, where it landed and the location of its controller.
paragraphs.quote: Pinpoint where the drone took off, where it landed and the location of its controller.

paragraphs.text: Alerts go out through SMS, Microsoft Teams, Slack, CommandCentral Aware or an existing ops stack.
paragraphs.quote: Instant notifications through SMS, Microsoft Teams, Slack, CommandCentral Aware, or your existing ops stack.

paragraphs.text: The platform produces forensic reports intended for law enforcement or federal agencies.
paragraphs.quote: Courtroom-ready forensic evidence you can take straight to law enforcement or federal agencies.

paragraphs.text: One case study describes how a near-miss drone flight over a crowd of 10,000 at Fort Adams State Park led Rhode Island toward a statewide drone detection strategy.
paragraphs.quote: A near-miss drone flight over a crowd of 10,000 at

paragraphs.text: The University of Illinois Police Department used SkySafe to monitor and respond to drone activity across campus events and facilities, and the University of Louisiana at Monroe uses it to separate authorized university flights from unauthorized activity.
paragraphs.quote: University of Illinois Police Department used SkySafe to monitor and respond to drone activity across major campus events and facilities.

paragraphs.text: Press releases on its site describe the product as a cloud-based SaaS platform providing real-time and historical drone data to help distinguish unauthorized drones from authorized ones.
paragraphs.quote: cloud-based SaaS platform offers comprehensive airspace awareness, providing real-time and historical drone data to help distinguish between unauthorized and authorized drones

paragraphs.text: In November 2025 it launched Forensics as a Service, which the company says lets agencies and organizations respond to and investigate drone incidents on their own.
paragraphs.quote: SkySafe announced the launch of Forensics as a Service (FaaS), a turnkey capability that enables law enforcement agencies, public safety teams, and organizations to independently respond to and investigate drone incidents

paragraphs.text: CEO Grant Jordan served as an officer in the US Air Force for four years after graduating from MIT and was President of Somerset Recon.
paragraphs.quote: Grant Jordan is CEO at SkySafe. After graduating from MIT, Grant served as an officer in the US Air Force for four years.

quote.text: Airspace is changing, even in the most secure environments. SkySafe enables you to detect, analyze, and act on every drone in your airspace.

paragraphs.text: Flash AI builds investigative software in Ohio for law enforcement agencies.

paragraphs.quote: Upload your entire caseload, video, audio, images, documents, and phone extractions, into one unified system.

paragraphs.text: Flash PD accepts 115+ file types and processes them in parallel.

paragraphs.quote: 33,004 high-risk signals identified. Zero manual review hours required.

paragraphs.text: Flash AI states that queries, uploads and conversations are never used to train AI models, and that hosting is on AWS infrastructure in the United States.
paragraphs.quote: Your queries, uploads, and conversations are never used to train AI models.

paragraphs.text: DefendEye sells autonomous drones to first responders, emergency services and private security teams.
paragraphs.quote: First Responders, Emergency Services, Private Security

paragraphs.text: A second product category is aimed at tactical, defense and government buyers.
paragraphs.quote: Tactical, Defense, Government Products

paragraphs.text: The pitch is situational awareness in seconds, an AI-powered search for people on the ground, and a drone that anyone can operate.
paragraphs.quote: Gain situational awareness in seconds. AI-powered people search. A drone so intuitive that anyone can operate it.

paragraphs.text: There is no pilot and no joystick: the operator controls the drone from a phone and launches it with a single tap.
paragraphs.quote: No joysticks, no special hardware. Control the drone directly from your phone and launch it with a single tap.

paragraphs.text: The company says deployment takes under 20 seconds through a single-button activation.
paragraphs.quote: Rapid deployment in under 20 seconds via single-button activation, designed for intuitive operation by any personnel.

paragraphs.text: One version launches automatically when motion sensors detect activity and returns to land in its box.
paragraphs.quote: Automatically launched by motion sensors the moment activity is detected.

paragraphs.text: Missions can be run remotely from any location through the DefendEye Cloud platform.
paragraphs.quote: Full remote operational control guaranteed from any global location via the DefendEye Cloud platform.

paragraphs.text: The company describes itself as a technology company focused on making aerial intelligence faster, simpler and more accessible.
paragraphs.quote: DefendEye is a technology company focused on making aerial intelligence faster, simpler and more accessible.

paragraphs.text: It says its systems can support emergency response, public safety, maritime operations and industrial environments.
paragraphs.quote: Our solutions can support emergency response, public safety, maritime operations, industrial environments, and other situations where rapid aerial awareness is important.

paragraphs: TRULEO sells software to law enforcement agencies that reads the databases a department already has and generates case solvability scores by connecting the dots and surfacing new leads. It sits on top of an agency's RMS and case management system rather than replacing them. When a detective runs a name, jail calls, RMS, OSINT, body-worn camera footage and more than 140 sources are cross-referenced automatically. What comes back are investigative next steps, new leads and ranked case solvability scores.

The same platform writes shift and intelligence briefings for patrol and command, drafts policies and recommends resource allocation. Earlier press releases describe TRULEO as body-worn camera review software, adopted by agencies such as the Washtenaw County Sheriff's Office and the Queen Creek Police Department. The company states the platform is 100% made in the USA, FBI CJIS compliant, and included in the FBI National Academy curriculum in Quantico, Virginia.

A 2026 press release describes an on-premise AI agent platform used by hundreds of law enforcement agencies across the US. The CEO and co-founder serves on the board of the FBI National Academy Foundation and has spent his career building COMINT platforms for financial compliance, intelligence and public safety agencies. The CTO and co-founder, Tejas Shastry, holds a PhD from Northwestern University.

quote.text: Modern Treasury for the Public Sector

paragraphs.text: Edwin sells treasury software to the finance teams inside public agencies, aimed at directors, treasurers, accountants and controllers.
paragraphs.quote: Edwin brings clarity, automation, and oversight to cash and investment operations

paragraphs.text: The problem it targets is a familiar one, where bank data sits in portals, ledger data sits in reports, and investment activity sits somewhere else again.
paragraphs.quote: Bank data lives in portals. ERP data lives in reports. Investment activity lives elsewhere.

paragraphs.text: An agency connects its bank and investment portals, and the platform maps that live data onto the chart of accounts already in the ERP.
paragraphs.quote: Edwin maps this live data to your existing ERP chart of accounts

paragraphs.text: Reconciliation between bank and ledger is automated, with anomalies, duplicates and missing entries flagged before they reach the books.
paragraphs.quote: Instantly flag anomalies, duplicates, or missing entries before they hit your ledger.

paragraphs.text: Investment holdings are checked against statute and local policy, with alerts when concentration limits are exceeded or a security falls outside policy.
paragraphs.quote: Get immediate alerts if concentration limits are exceeded or if a security falls out of policy.

paragraphs.text: Agencies can also compare portfolio yield, risk and allocation against peers of similar size to justify decisions to a council or treasury board.
paragraphs.quote: Compare your portfolio’s yield, risk, and allocation against peer agencies of similar size

paragraphs.text: The company says implementation takes days and requires no migration of existing ledger data.
paragraphs.quote: Implementation takes days, requiring zero migration of your existing ledger data

paragraphs.text: Edwin was started by Peter Rogers and Soroosh Demooei after they sat through city council meetings across Los Angeles County.
paragraphs.quote: Peter and Soroosh started Edwin to build the tools those teams deserved.

paragraphs.text: Investors named on the site include Watertower Ventures, Wonder Ventures and Liquid 2.
paragraphs.quote: Edwin is supported by Watertower Ventures, Wonder Ventures, Liquid 2

paragraphs.text: The platform is described as SOC 2 certified with full activity logging and traceability.
paragraphs.quote: SOC 2 certified with full activity logging and traceability

before.why: A single but detailed product page describing the tethered drone, its cameras, software, configurations and regulatory position.

proposal.why: A single but detailed product page describing the tethered drone, its cameras, software, configurations and regulatory position.
proposal.evidence: Home page covers the Sigma aircraft, Fotokite Live software, camera sensors, power, streaming, API, configurations, and EU funding.

quote.text: Operate as long as your mission requires.

paragraphs.text: Fotokite makes tethered drones that give fire departments and other first responders a camera looking down on an incident.
paragraphs.quote: Fotokite Sigma provides public safety teams with mission-critical situational awareness from elevated perspectives.

paragraphs.text: The aircraft launches, flies, and lands at the push of a single button, so no crew member has to act as a pilot.
paragraphs.quote: launching, flying, and landing with the single push of a button; no piloting required.

paragraphs.text: The company states that aviation authorities recognize its actively tethered design as a safer option than free-flying public safety drone systems.
paragraphs.quote: Fotokite Sigma is authorized and recognized by aviation authorities as a safer alternative to non-actively tethered drones and free-flying public safety drone systems.

paragraphs.text: The camera package pairs a radiometric thermal camera with wide-angle and zoom color cameras on a three-axis gimbal.
paragraphs.quote: a radiometric thermal camera, a wide-angle color camera, and a zoom color camera mounted on a three-axis gimbal

paragraphs.text: Drawing power from the vehicle that carries it, the Sigma can stay up for as long as a mission lasts.
paragraphs.quote: Integrated into your vehicle’s power supply, the Fotokite Sigma will remain operational for the duration of your mission.

paragraphs.text: Crews watch the feed through Fotokite Live, the tablet software written for the aircraft.
paragraphs.quote: Fotokite Live is the native operating software for the Fotokite Sigma.

paragraphs.text: Color and thermal video can also be streamed to remote viewers over the internet by Wi-Fi or mobile network.
paragraphs.quote: stream live color and thermal to remote viewers over the Internet via Wi-Fi or mobile networks

paragraphs.text: Public safety teams use the system on live fire responses and search and rescue missions.
paragraphs.quote: From live fire responses to search and rescue missions, public safety teams are now using the Fotokite Sigma everyday as an essential tool for their missions.

paragraphs.text: In the United States, the company says the system is exempt from Part 107 and COA requirements.
paragraphs.quote: Exempt from Pt. 107 and COA (USA)

paragraphs.text: One version ships in a transport case so the system can move between vehicles.
paragraphs.quote: The Transport Case configuration allows the use of the Fotokite Sigma to be interchangeable between vehicles

paragraphs.text: An API is offered so customers and partners can build their own integrations and automations.
paragraphs.quote: The API is intended to allow customers and partners to build their own integrations and automations with ease.

paragraphs.text: The company also notes funding from the European Union's Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme.
paragraphs.quote: This project has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme

before.name: For The Record (FTR)

paragraphs.text: For The Record makes recording technology for courts, capturing what is said in a proceeding and turning it into text that can be searched.
paragraphs.quote: advanced audio capture, real-time speech-to-text, secure cloud-based storage, and instant access to records

paragraphs.text: One audience is court administrators trying to keep operations running at lower cost.
paragraphs.quote: help court administrators run more efficient, economical, and resilient operations

paragraphs.text: Judges are a second audience, able to pull up audio, video, and speech-to-text without leaving the bench.
paragraphs.quote: Instantly access audio, video, and speech-to-text transcripts without leaving the bench.

paragraphs.text: Recording runs on multiple audio channels, so individual speakers stay distinct even when they talk over one another.
paragraphs.quote: Multi-channel audio capture isolates speakers for clarity, even with overtalk in noisy environments.

paragraphs.text: Courts that need local infrastructure can run the FTR Gold software in the courthouse rather than in the cloud.
paragraphs.quote: Reliable, on-premises recording for courts with local infrastructure needs

paragraphs.text: The cloud option is described as centralized storage built to NIST 800-53 Rev. 5 with more than a thousand security and privacy controls.
paragraphs.quote: Centralized, secure storage meeting NIST 800-53 Rev. 5 standards with 1,200+ security and privacy controls

paragraphs.text: Access is governed by role-based permissions, audit trails, and encryption of both transmission and storage.
paragraphs.quote: role-based access, audit trails, and encrypted transmission and storage

paragraphs.text: The company says it supports courts in more than 80 countries.
paragraphs.quote: Supporting courts in more than 80 countries around the world

paragraphs.text: Its software is API-ready and meant to sit alongside the case management and evidence systems a court already runs.
paragraphs.quote: API-ready and designed to work with your existing Case Management Systems, evidence management, or other infrastructure

paragraphs.text: The work extends past software into specifying equipment and installing courtroom hardware.
paragraphs.quote: from equipment specification to hardware installation

quote.text: A court record is the official, permanent account of a legal case.

paragraphs.text: Greyparrot turns the waste passing through materials recovery facilities into data, serving both the teams that sort materials and the brands that design them.

paragraphs.text: The practice this displaces, manual sampling, ties up operator hours and covers less than 0.1% of throughput.

before.name: Outsight SA
before.why: The home, platform, and vision pages describe the software, the tracking method, the privacy design, the project lifecycle, and the scale of deployment.
before.evidence: Platform page mechanics plus home page and vision page positioning.

paragraphs.text: Outsight sells software that turns 3D sensor feeds into a running account of how people, vehicles, and robots move through a site.
paragraphs.quote: An end-to-end software solution combining Physical AI, multi-sensor fusion, and real-time analytics to continuously digitize the movement of people, vehicles, and robots across entire sites.

paragraphs.text: The buyers are operators of large shared spaces such as airports, hospitals, and factories.
paragraphs.quote: Across airports, hospitals, factories, and beyond

paragraphs.text: Anything entering the scene is given an anonymous identifier and held to centimeter precision until it leaves.
paragraphs.quote: Anonymous IDs are assigned at the moment of entry and maintained with centimeter precision, uninterrupted, until exit.

paragraphs.text: No faces or plates are captured, only the geometry of motion.
paragraphs.quote: faces, no plates, just the geometry of motion.

paragraphs.text: Operators define zones and the measures they care about, such as counting, density, queue length, wait time and throughput, and the analytics engine computes them continuously.
paragraphs.quote: (counting, density, queue length, wait time, throughput, resource utilisation), and the analytics engine computes them continuously

paragraphs.text: Results come back as live 3D playback, custom indicators, alerts, dashboards, and APIs.
paragraphs.quote: Live 3D playback, custom KPIs, alerts, dashboards, and APIs

paragraphs.text: Before any of that, a multi-vendor simulator tests layouts and sensor mixes and proposes the hardware configuration.
paragraphs.quote: multi-vendor simulator evaluates layouts and sensor mixes against those goals and proposes the hardware configuration

paragraphs.text: The company says the platform is deployed at scale across five continents.
paragraphs.quote: Deployed at scale across five continents

paragraphs.text: It calls the result a Motional Digital Twin and says these are running in production.
paragraphs.quote: Motional Digital Twins run in production

paragraphs.text: Its newsroom announces a strategic partnership with AWS around spatial AI in aviation.
paragraphs.quote: Outsight and AWS Sign Strategic Partnership to Accelerate Spatial AI adoption in Aviation

paragraphs.text: The pitch behind all of it is that movement is the next layer of business to be digitized.
paragraphs.quote: The physical world is the next layer of business to be digitized

quote.text: The bottleneck of Physical AI is not models, it is real-world data

paragraphs.quote: Rank replacement candidates by measured load

paragraphs.quote: Bring pole loading, asset condition, vegetation, GIS accuracy, weather, and consequence together in a physics-backed model

paragraphs.text: Resiliency work prioritizes mitigation by how asset condition, vegetation proximity and environmental conditions interact across the network.
paragraphs.quote: Prioritize mitigation work based on how asset condition and behavior, vegetation proximity, and environmental conditions interact across the network in every scenario.

paragraphs.text: Propel makes a mobile app for people who receive government benefits on an EBT card, pitched on its own site as the simplest way to check a balance and save money.
paragraphs.quote: The simplest way to check your EBT balance, save money, and much more.

paragraphs.text: The app itself costs nothing to use.
paragraphs.quote: The Propel app is completely free to use.

paragraphs.text: With the cardholder's permission, Propel connects to their state benefits portal.
paragraphs.quote: Propel connects to your state's portal with your permission.

paragraphs.text: It then gathers the EBT balance and transaction history, makes that easier to read, and displays it in the app.
paragraphs.quote: Then, Propel gathers your EBT balance and transaction history, makes it easier to read, and displays it in the app.

paragraphs.text: That spares people from calling a 1-800 number or logging in to a state website.
paragraphs.quote: This means you don't need to call a 1-800 number or log in to a state website.

paragraphs.text: Balance checking works in 49 states, the District of Columbia, and several U.S. territories.
paragraphs.quote: The Propel app offers balance checking in 49 states, the District of Columbia, and several U.S. territories

paragraphs.text: Iowa is the exception.
paragraphs.quote: Balance checking is currently not available in Iowa.

paragraphs.text: The app also carries card security features such as suspicious activity monitoring and out of state transaction blocking.
paragraphs.quote: EBT security features, like suspicious activity monitoring & out of state transaction blocking

paragraphs.text: The company says it was founded to make government benefits better at the speed and scale recipients deserve.
paragraphs.quote: We founded Propel to build technology that makes people’s government benefits better, at the speed and scale they deserve.

paragraphs.text: The company points to more than a million 5-star reviews of the app.
paragraphs.quote: Download the app with over 1 million 5-star reviews.

paragraphs.text: Money comes from advertising.
paragraphs.quote: We make money through advertising, but we’re selective about what we promote.

paragraphs.text: Most of the promotions are free or discounted services available only to EBT cardholders.
paragraphs.quote: Most offers are free or discounted services only available to EBT cardholders

paragraphs.text: Propel also runs surveys that reach millions of users nationwide.
paragraphs.quote: Our surveys reach millions of users nationwide, gaining valuable feedback on how users are feeling

paragraphs.text: It says those findings give insight to policymakers working to improve state and federal benefits programs.
paragraphs.quote: they also provide valuable insight to policymakers working hard to improve state and federal benefits programs

quote.text: We founded Propel to build technology that makes people’s government benefits better, at the speed and scale they deserve.

before.name: Virtual Peaker
before.why: The platform and suite pages spell out what each product does, which devices it reaches, and the security certification the company claims.

paragraphs.text: Virtual Peaker sells cloud software that lets an electric utility reach the smart devices already sitting in homes and businesses and use them to shave peak load and cost.
paragraphs.quote: Connect smart devices to run residential, commercial, and industrial demand flexibility programs that leverage DERs to reduce cost and peak load with a Grid-Edge DERMS.

paragraphs.text: The buyers are utilities standing up demand response programs.
paragraphs.quote: Modern utilities use Virtual Peaker to launch demand response programs.

paragraphs.text: Three suites make up the product, and the company presents them together as a virtual power plant platform that aggregates distributed energy resources at the edge of the grid.
paragraphs.quote: When combined, all three suites make a powerful, all-in-one VPP platform for aggregating distributed energy resources at the grid-edge.

paragraphs.text: The Shift suite is the dispatch side, aggregating resources at homes and at commercial and industrial sites to hold down peak market costs and defer new construction.
paragraphs.quote: the Shift Grid-Edge DERMS Suite can minimize peak energy market costs, defer expensive new construction costs, and enhance grid resiliency by aggregating DERs at both the residential and commercial and industrial levels.

paragraphs.text: The Relay suite handles the customer side, signing people up and paying out the incentives.
paragraphs.quote: simplify customer enrollment, and process customer incentives through the Relay Customer Engagement suite

paragraphs.text: A utility can run several program types at once across electric vehicles, thermostats, water heaters and batteries.
paragraphs.quote: Utilities can run all DER program types in one integrated platform, including EVs, smart thermostats, water heaters, batteries, and more.

paragraphs.text: The company describes partnerships with more than thirty device types, from thermostats to electric vehicle chargers.
paragraphs.quote: Partnering with over 30 device types, including smart thermostats, water heaters, batteries, and EV chargers

paragraphs.text: It states that the platform is SOC 2 Type 2 certified.
paragraphs.quote: As a SOC 2 Type 2 certified platform

paragraphs.text: Municipal energy providers are named as one audience, using demand response to meet grid goals and engage customers.
paragraphs.quote: For municipal energy providers, DR programs help meet new grid goals and engage customers while building trust.

paragraphs.text: One published case study covers Sacramento Municipal Utility District optimizing hot water heater efficiency on the platform.

quote.text: Modern utilities use Virtual Peaker to launch demand response programs.

paragraphs.text: The main application collects data from across an agency so teams can follow trends and produce the reports decisions rest on.
paragraphs.quote: TransTrack Manager™ brings together data from across your organization so teams can track performance, monitor trends, and generate the reports needed for informed decision-making.

paragraphs.text: The firm was formed in 2002 by transit management professionals.
paragraphs.quote: TransTrack Systems® was formed in 2002 by transit management professionals who understand the need for streamlined processes and improved management reporting.

paragraphs.quote: For more than 20 years, TransTrack Systems has helped transit agencies turn operational data into better decisions.

paragraphs.quote: Transit financial planning and cost analyses.

paragraphs.text: The platform itself was built with transit professionals involved.
paragraphs.quote: Developed in collaboration with transit professionals, the platform reflects real-world agency needs and workflows.

after.name: AirBadge
after.why: The home page sets out what the software does, which systems it feeds, the regulations it targets, its cloud hosting, an airport count and a named access control certification.

paragraphs.text: AirBadge sells identity management software to airports in the United States, aimed at the badge office that issues and renews credentials.
paragraphs.quote: Elevate your airport’s badging office operations with AirBadge: an airport identity management solution built for U.S. airports.

paragraphs.text: The company says it puts all of its resources into aviation so the software fits airport operations and TSA regulations.
paragraphs.quote: We dedicate 100% of our resources to the aviation industry, ensuring our solutions meet the unique demands of airport operations and TSA regulations.

paragraphs.text: The product is described as built for 1542 and part 139 airports.
paragraphs.quote: Built exclusively for 1542 and part 139 airports

paragraphs.text: Applicants and badge holders enter their own details into the system.
paragraphs.quote: Applicants and badge holders enter their own information into AirBadge.

paragraphs.text: Authorized signatories use it to invite new hires to apply and to authorize or block renewals.
paragraphs.quote: Use AirBadge to invite new hires to apply for a badge, authorize or prevent renewals, manage badges, and more.

paragraphs.quote: Fully managed cloud infrastructure and security

paragraphs.quote: AirBadge’s software interfaces with the LenelS2 OnGuard access control system

after.name: ASTERRA
after.why: The home, platform, EarthWorks and MasterPlan pages explain the sensing method, the two named products, the software that delivers results and the markets served.

paragraphs.text: ASTERRA sells insight into what lies beneath the ground, produced without breaking ground using patented algorithms and artificial intelligence to detect leaks.
paragraphs.quote: Without breaking ground, ASTERRA uses patented algorithms and artificial intelligence to detect leaks

paragraphs.text: Water and wastewater utilities use it for leak detection to reduce non-revenue water and for analysis of potable and wastewater systems.
paragraphs.quote: Supports leak detection to reduce NRW and provides analysis for potable and wastewater systems for proactive remediation and efficient crew use.

paragraphs.text: The same approach maps excess soil moisture near or under dams, levees, roads, railways and mining operations.
paragraphs.quote: By mapping excess soil moisture near or under dams, levees, roads, railways, and mining operations from space

paragraphs.text: The company images a customer's system with polarimetric synthetic aperture radar to sense and evaluate soil moisture.
paragraphs.quote: ASTERRA images your system using polarimetric synthetic aperture radar (PolSAR) to sense and evaluate soil moisture in close proximity.

paragraphs.text: The same regions are revisited every few days or weeks as needed to monitor vast expanses.
paragraphs.quote: We revisit the same regions every few days or weeks as needed to monitor vast expanses.

paragraphs.text: Results land in EO Discover, described as the repository for all insights from a customer's ASTERRA projects.
paragraphs.quote: EO Discover is the repository for all insights from your ASTERRA projects.

paragraphs.text: There, detections, hotspots and network risk appear in a single view.
paragraphs.quote: Visualize detections, hotspots, and network risk in a single view.

paragraphs.text: MasterPlan scores pipe segments that show non-surfacing leaks and analyzes leak clusters over time.
paragraphs.quote: The algorithm scores pipe segments exhibiting non-surfacing leaks and analyzes leak clusters over time.

paragraphs.text: EarthWorks uses synthetic aperture radar to detect soil moisture up to 10 feet below the surface.
paragraphs.quote: synthetic aperture radar (SAR) to detect soil moisture up to 10 feet (3m) below the surface

paragraphs.text: Field crews log investigation results, leak location and other data using U-Collect or the Esri ArcGIS Field Maps app.
paragraphs.quote: U-Collect or Esri ArcGIS Field Maps app to log investigation results, leak location, and other data

paragraphs.text: Within five minutes that reporting is available in EO Discover.
paragraphs.quote: Within five minutes, their reporting is available in EO Discover.

paragraphs.text: The company ties EarthWorks, MasterPlan and Recover to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals.
paragraphs.quote: ASTERRA EarthWorks, MasterPlan, and Recover are effective solutions our customers can use to meet the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

paragraphs.text: MasterPlan is available in the Advise level of an ASTERRA Recover subscription.
paragraphs.quote: MasterPlan is available in the Advise level of an ASTERRA Recover subscription.

quote.text: ASTERRA provides a number of industries with intelligence and insights from beneath the surface of their largest installations.

after.name: Applied Information
after.why: The homepage and three solution pages spell out the Glance platform, the cabinet data it reports, how preemption works step by step, and the company's statement about where its hardware is built.

paragraphs.text: Applied Information makes traffic technology that turns intersections, school zones and connected vehicles into one real-time system.
paragraphs.quote: Applied Information’s Glance® platform and smart-city solutions turn intersections, school zones, and connected vehicles into a unified, real-time system

paragraphs.text: The customers are cities, which manage their traffic and ITS assets through a web-based application called Glance.
paragraphs.quote: allows cities to manage all their traffic and ITS assets under one, easy-to-use web-based application.

paragraphs.text: Glance monitors intersection cabinet equipment, reporting AC power, battery back up, cabinet flash, stop time, conflict monitor status, door switches, fan status and vehicle detectors.
paragraphs.quote: Data includes incoming AC power, battery back up, cabinet flash, stop time, conflict monitor status, door switches, fan status, vehicle detectors and more.

paragraphs.text: For emergency vehicles, an in-vehicle unit uses a cellular signal to tell the system a route has started.
paragraphs.quote: The moment a route starts, the in-vehicle unit uses a cellular signal to alert Glance of the emergency call.

paragraphs.text: The system works out the route and talks wirelessly to the traffic cabinet to clear traffic ahead of the vehicle.
paragraphs.quote: Glance processes the route and communicates wirelessly with the traffic cabinet to clear traffic ahead of the vehicle’s arrival.

paragraphs.text: School beacon flashers and their schedules can be viewed and controlled from anywhere.
paragraphs.quote: cities can easily view and control school beacon flashers and their schedules from anywhere

paragraphs.text: A connected vehicle product communicates over C-V2X, 4G LTE cellular and 900MHz.
paragraphs.quote: The Applied Information Connected Vehicle System simplifies and enables communication with C-V2X, 4G LTE cellular communication, and 900MHZ.

paragraphs.text: The company states its hardware is designed, assembled and tested in Alpharetta, Georgia, with components meeting domestic content thresholds.
paragraphs.quote: hardware is designed, assembled, and tested in Alpharetta, Georgia using components that meet the required domestic content thresholds

paragraphs.text: A connected school bus system warns drivers approaching an active school safety zone or exceeding the speed limit.
paragraphs.quote: The Applied Information Connected School Bus System warns drivers when they are approaching an active school safety zone or are exceeding the speed limit

paragraphs.text: A smartphone app, Glance TravelSafely, extends the technology to residents.
paragraphs.quote: Extend smart city technology to your citizens with Glance TravelSafely.

quote.text: The drivers know they’ve got a green light in front of them, they know that everyone else has a red light, and they know the traffic is going to move ahead of them.
